notes.title: Update v.0.3.486
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update v.0.3.486[/b][/h1]

[b]Changes:[/b]
*) Now after loading saves the game will not be re-saved again, which was the case before
*) Now the dialogue panels of units will not overlap each other
*) Completely switched to a new save system (the old ones will not work)!!!
*) Now the Overground Lamp building will not have an inventory
*) In the game settings, the FPS limit has moved to the Graphics tab
*) The unit preview scene in the inventory has been slightly optimized
*) Now the mining beam of the tool will correctly hit the props when mining or resolving
*) The prop colliders have been updated, which has slightly increased the performance when working with them
*) Now when you click on the header of a window that can be moved, it will automatically move to the foreground, on top of all other windows
*) Updated the visual of the item separation window
*) The Add all fuel button has been removed if there is only one resource in the inventory
*) The Gas Storage, Marketplace, Steam Energy, Teleport, Gas Purification, Ore Purification technologies have been made more expensive
*) The inventory size of the Component Factory building has been reduced from 6x4 to 5x4
*) Now Energy cells will be highlighted when fully charged (provided that they remain in the charging slot)
*) Now the Accumulation Station building can be visually seen on the model how many charging slots are currently occupied
*) Now the icons when dragged in the inventory will be the same size as the main ones
*) Now it will be impossible to remove the inventory expansion module from the building
*) The visual of the panel with information about the module has been corrected
*) The visual of the item tooltip has been corrected
*) The size of the Sorting Window has been increased from 10x10 to 10x20
*) Optimized the creation of inventory cells, now they load a little faster
*) It will no longer be possible to enter special characters when editing the preset name
*) The number of characters in the name has been limited to 15
*) The animation of the destruction of trees and rocks has been updated
*) Now the icon of an item that is being dismantled will darken and become inactive
*) The cost has been increased and production time of some complex components
*) Now the Sawmill will consume electricity when planting vegetation
*) The detection radius of buried containers has been reduced from 25 units to 15
*) Now scanning buried containers will take some time
*) Now when starting the game, the music volume will gradually increase
*) Now when you click on the information panel "Take resources from the landing shuttle" the building will be highlighted
*) Now when units take resources from the building, they will also place them in the Forward compartment if the main one is full
*) Now when saving the world manually through the settings window, a special indicator will appear that the world is being saved. It will be clearer when saving is in progress
*) Now when disassembling modules or containers, nested items will also be taken into account
*) Now in the Disassembly window, new items will try to stack, and not multiply throughout the window
*) It will now be impossible to disassemble a container item that is in the equipped state (for example, the Rear Compartment of a unit). In order to disassemble it, you will first need to remove it
*) Now the laser beam will be synchronized with the animation of the tool movement during mining
*) Now the dialog panel that appears above the unit will have a time indicator in the form of a slider, after which this panel will close
*) Hidden unavailable technologies in the information panel in the Technology window
*) Changed the recipe for building a Crusher
*) Optimized the window with a list of changes
*) Now in Wikipedia, in the Cleaning section, recipes that can be obtained from this resource will also be shown
*) Now in the tips for building, information about energy consumption or production will be duplicated
*) Optimized the chassis animation - it will not play when the camera is at maximum zoom
*) Now the animation for building a Network Tower will play when at least one network element is connected to it
*) Now Energy Cells of tools can be charged in the Energy Storage Station

[b]Added:[/b]
*) Added a new starting task - Resource extraction
*) Added a hint to the item tooltip that the module cannot be removed from the building
*) Added the ability to edit the unit name in the Building window, to do this, click on the name and editing will become available
*) Added Brightness and Gamma settings
*) Added drawing of the satellite orbit (necessary for the mechanics of the Space Station)
*) Added effects after the destruction of stones
*) Added effects to the construction of the Research Station
*) Added display of units in the world window
*) Added a starting scene with a trailer
*) Added an indicator of the energy consumption of the unit to the inventory
*) Added information about energy consumption or production to the Wikipedia for buildings
*) Added the content Empty on the Resource Analysis panel in the world window
*) Added the ability to move a building that has not yet been built
*) For the Scanning Station, the state - Technology is not researched in the Buildings window
*) Added display of the Energy Cell charge on the tool icon
*) Added - now buildings that have been placed but not built yet will change color when you hover over them
*) Now the energy charge of tools will be gradually spent

[b]Fixed:[/b]
*) Fixed the problem when Wikipedia did not open in the inventory by pressing F1
*) Fixed a bug when in the settings on the Antialiasing slot it always showed Off
*) Fixed the problem when the sound was completely turned off and after turning it on there was still no sound until you click Apply
*) Fixed the problem when it was impossible to exit the unit's inventory by pressing Esc or I
*) Fixed Pause and Resume the game by pressing the Space key
*) Fixed the problem when at the start of the game, at the landing stage, the auxiliary panel with control buttons in the lower left corner of the screen was not visible
*) Fixed the overlap of the main buttons in the inventory
*) Fixed a bug when after removing a critical module from a tool in the modding window, the tool icon did not update and did not turn red
*) Fixed a bug when after completing all the starting tasks, the window with congratulations that the player has completed the training tasks did not appear
*) The animation of opening and closing windows has been fixed. Now they appear from the center of the window header, and not from the upper left corner
*) Fixed a bug where the Component Factory could take resources from the Resource Cleaning Station that it was currently using
*) Fixed a bug where it was impossible to enter Grid mode by pressing the T key during a mission
*) Fixed a bug where the Network Tower did not turn off its animation when deleting a building
*) Fixed a bug with a tooltip on units, the tooltip disappeared when moving the mouse cursor if the unit has no items in its inventory
*) Fixed a bug where when charging an Energy Cell in an Accumulation Station, the Energy Cell could have more charge than its capacity
*) Fixed a bug where the tooltip on an item could fall beyond the screen boundaries
*) Fixed a bug where you could endlessly disassemble the same item through the Disassembly Window
*) Fixed a bug where when deleting a module in the Overview Window toolbar with modules was hidden
*) Fixed a bug where special characters could be entered in any search bar
*) Fixed a bug where the text of the hovered area in the planet window was not updated after changing the planet preview layer
*) Fixed a bug where pressing Esc did not close the Item Overview window in the inventory, but instead closed the inventory itself
*) Fixed a bug where after scanning buried containers there were still unknown items in the hints
*) Fixed a bug where after canceling construction (when construction has not yet begun but resources have been loaded) resources are not returned to the container
*) Fixed a bug where after canceling the creation of a new world the panel with Extended tile information became active
*) Fixed a bug where after loading a location, the animation of the Landing button lagged
*) Fixed a bug where some buttons were not released after pressing
*) Fixed a bug where it was possible to complete a task with all buildings connected to one network while not connected to one network
*) Fixed a bug where after canceling technology research (provided that no chip grant has been spent yet) a research progress indicator appeared on the technology slot
*) Fixed a bug where after loading saves the camera was much lower than it was during saving
*) Fixed a bug where after loading saves some modules did not immediately apply effects (for example, expanding the rear compartment of a unit)
*) Fixed - now the Barrel, Side Handle of the Mjolnir tool are considered critical elements, without which it cannot work
*) Fixed a bug where it was possible to disassemble a unit module that cannot be removed without special tools (Workshop)
*) Fixed a bug where after deleting an open container, its overview window did not close
*) Fixed a bug where after deleting an item it still remained in the disassembly window
*) Fixed a bug where after activating a building it continued to work, although there was no power in the network
*) Fixed a bug where after saving the world through the Menu window the current save was not displayed in the Saves panel
*) Fixed a bug where the unit and its inventory were not saved if its Inventory was open at that moment
*) Fixed a bug where after closing the building window the item splitting window remained open
*) Fixed a bug where after disassembling a module or tool that is on a unit slot, the components were not created in the unit's inventory
*) Fixed a bug where in the building window on the production panel the quantity did not correspond to the actual value
*) Fixed a bug where it was possible to lay a network with the window open or when the cursor entered the UI area
*) Fixed a bug where in the network laying mode with the window open it was possible to exit the mode by pressing Esc
*) Fixed bug where birds were flying chaotically in a location with a large number of trees
*) Fixed a bug where the laser sound was not heard after exiting the inventory
*) Fixed a bug where the Component Creation Window did not close when the Construction Window was closed
*) Fixed a bug where the unit tool cast a shadow from the unit's flashlight
*) Fixed a bug where when quickly transferring items from a virtual container to the construction inventory, the cells in the unit's inventory were freed up, after which the new items overlapped each other
*) Fixed a bug where an item would freeze when quickly moving it to the space window
*) Fixed a bug where when transferring items to the Front Compartment, which is not on the slot
*) Fixed a bug where some modules that are attached to the unit's head could not be transferred to the head (the item was in the inventory, not on the slots)
*) Fixed a bug where in the unit's inventory it was impossible to it was necessary to enter a space in the unit name when editing
*) Fixed a bug where the Remove from queue icon was visible when dragging a technology
*) Fixed a bug where nothing could be heard when setting the sound volume to 50
*) Fixed a bug where the Pause and No Power icons overlapped after deactivating a building
*) Fixed a bug where the hint would appear in the upper right corner for a moment and then move to the cursor
*) Fixed a bug where it was impossible to select a building or unit if the cursor was over an area with task slots (while there were no tasks themselves)
*) Fixed a bug where the state of the Do not show again button in the Tutorial window was not saved. Now the windows will not open even if you start a new game. You can also find them on Wikipedia
*) Fixed a bug where the unit's lantern did not cast a shadow on the props that the cursor was hovering over
*) Fixed a bug where the unit's module tooltips displayed a message that the module could not be removed (this message applies to building modules)
*) Fixed a bug where after loading a save, buildings had no animation
*) Fixed a bug where after exiting the game to the main menu it was impossible to click the Sandbox button
*) Fixed a bug where when changing the prop selection mode to copying buildings, the tooltip panel with controls did not disappear
*) Fixed a bug where after loading fuel into the Thermal Power Plant, items overlapped each other in the unit's inventory when mining
*) Fixed a bug where when dragging an item in the Building Window, if you press Esc (try to close the window), the icon froze
*) Fixed layering panels with control tips when placing a building on the buttons of the wind, stone and water palette
*) Fixed a bug in the Item Overview Window - in the modules tab, if you remove the last one, the panel does not switch to the main tab
*) Fixed a bug when deleting a Drilling Station, the panel overlapped the resource icon
*) Fixed a bug of multiple duplication of the Resources have been added panel, which appears on the unit

notes.title: Update v.0.2.991 (22.12.2023)
notes.content:
[h1][b]​​​​​​​Happy upcoming holidays![/b][/h1]

[b]Update v.0.2.991[/b]

Changes:
1) The size of the Disassembly window has been adjusted
2) Now when you close the Building window, the Disassembly window will also closed
3) The dawn in the game has been slightly shifted. Now dawn will be at 6:20, previously it was at 7:10 (required for the correct operation of the unit’s flashlight functionality)
4) The appearance of the panel for resource mining and destruction of buildings has been changed. Added maximum indicator and name of the current process
5) The number of technologies displayed has been increased to 6 in the Technology inspect window (previously there were 2)
6) Increased the processing time of all ores by 50%. This change is necessary because New technologies will soon be introduced to improve these indicators
7) Optimization has been carried out with updating the item texts. Previously, the text was updated for all items after each operation of splitting, movement, etc.
8) The preset selection window in the Constructor window has been optimized. Now presets load even faster
9) The logic for processing resources has been adjusted. The minimum amount of resources that can be obtained after clearing is now 1 (previously it was possible to get 0), and the maximum will be in the range from 1 to max
10) Increased the time of spilling resources from Barrels by 2 times
11) Now, after spilling Barrels with resources, an Empty Barrel will be created in their place (provided that the resource has been completely removed from the barrel)
12) The creation of items in the inventory of the Trading floor has been optimized. When switching between traders, items will be placed in the buffer and retrieved from there as needed
13) Now, when dragging items in the inventory, containers that have free space will be highlighted
14) Now the Virtual container button will be highlighted when there are items in it
15) Changed the base storage size of the Power collector station building from 4x2 to 4x3 (since it was impossible to remove the building’s Energy Cell from the charging slots)
16) Now, when dragging building modules in the Building window, the module slots to which this module can be attached will be highlighted, provided that it is compatible with the building
17) The production time of all components has been increased by 2 times. This change is necessary because New technologies will soon be introduced to improve these indicators

Added:
1) Added a new item - Geodata
2) Added the ability to add a unit to the queue for resource extraction, provided that the unit is currently extracting one of the resources (stone, wood).
To do this, call the context menu on the desired resource and select Add to queue. The unit must be selected!
3) For the Surface scanning station, a new panel has been added to the Building window, which displays all resource deposits that are nearby
4) A flashlight has been added to units; it will automatically turn on at night and turn off with the first rays of the Sun.
This mechanic is attached to the Device module. The power consumption of the flashlight is still the same for everyone - 5% of the base consumption (0.2 kW)
5) Now Devices (modules for units) can carry the functionality of a Flashlight, this characteristic will be generated randomly
6) You can now add an item to your favorites in the unit's inventory. To add an item to your favorites, it must belong to a unit
Selected items cannot be automatically transferred to a building or anywhere else (for example, through the Unload all to building action). The functionality will expand!
7) The Drilling section has been added to the Water converter in the Building window. Now mining can be paused
8) Now Energy Cells can be dragged and attached to charging slots in the Building window
9) The Resource Barrel item has a numeric display of its contents added
10) For the Thermal Power Plant, a tooltip about the lack of fuel in the inventory has been added
11) Now, when Buried Containers are discovered, they will be displayed on the minimap and on the global map

Corrected:
1) Fixed an issue where the tooltip on resource deposits did not appear
2) Fixed an error in sending technology for research. An error occurred when a player quickly submitted and canceled research on one technology
3) Fixed an issue where, while placing a building, it was possible to Focus on the building through the Building window
4) Now after disassembling an item, its components will spawn correctly in the building’s inventory
5) Fixed a bug when dragging the Back or Front trunk the corresponding slot in the unit’s inventory was not highlighted
6) Wikipedia - fixed a problem where when you clicked the Open wiki button in the Cleaning or Producing components section, nothing happened
7) Fixed a bug where a tooltip on vegetation could appear when the cursor was in the mini-map area
8) Fixed a bug when the tool icon remained active after deactivating the tool
9) Fixed an issue where it was impossible to enter the number of components produced through the Confirmation window, the input field did not work correctly
10) Fixed an issue where the Spilling Station did not spill the barrels, but removed them from inventory
11) Fixed a problem where, during the activity of the Research Collector task, the player could research any other available technology, while losing the opportunity to research the required technology
12) Fixed a bug when, in the Power Scanning mode, the value of Energy Consumption for buildings remained marked in red, although there was electricity in the web
13) Fixed a bug when, after moving from the slots of a unit’s module to an unopened container (for example, moving the Device to the Back trunk, which is in the unit’s inventory), it saved the state of the module attached to the unit
14) Fixed a bug when, after installing a module to expand the storage of a building, the unit’s inventory area also changed (became smaller, which made it difficult to access all items in the Back trunk)
15) Fixed a problem when in the Building window it was possible to remove some modules from a unit that required a special tool
16) Fixed a problem where in the Item Inspect Window, when scrolling through information about an item using LMB, without releasing the LMB, it was possible to rotate the item in the Preview panel
17) Fixed a bug when in the Constructor some scene objects were visible through the icons
18) An attempt was made to fix the error when a black screen appeared when the game was launched (if this problem occurs, report it to the developer, do not forget to send .log files)
19) Fixed a bug when the icon of resource deposits on the global map was displayed incorrectly (showed None)
20) Fixed a problem where components were not created when disassembling a building module

notes.title: Update v.0.2.576
notes.content:
[b]v.0.2.576 (11.11.2023)[/b]

[img]https://sun9-49.userapi.com/impg/3n-j7mnaMhqkTQSDZzpskbR60XW52U06o7c1ng/ZmQ2c7AKxDE.jpg?size=800x450&quality=95&sign=9e2e339a341a54db5b1c1c8458edcb90&type=album[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b]
1) Drones can now repair buildings. For this, the Technical Drone Station is used. Research the technology to activate it. (needs testing)
2) Reduced the size of the game save file (by an average of 40% by replacing the json format with bin ([b]old saves will not work[/b]))
3) Localization and text, some edits
4) Game performance has been slightly increased by removing unnecessary operations to check whether the cursor enters the area of UI elements
5) The icon for sending technologies for research has been changed
6) Slightly improved elements of the Technologies window
7) Technologies Solar energy and Wind energy have been increased in price - another type of chip grant has been added
8) Now some commands in the context menu will be highlighted in colors (for example, Clear resource in the Sawmill)
9) Component Disassembly Window - now when dragging items, the icon in the Disassembly Window will be highlighted, indicating that the component can be disassembled
10) Component Disassembly Window - now after disassembly, items will be created directly in the unit’s inventory
11) Now the unit tooltip will take into account the resources located in the Front trunk
12) The logic of the Item Splitting window has been slightly changed - now when you click outside the window or separate an item, it will not close
13) Now, when you reopen the Building Window, the unit panel will load even faster
14) Now items will display a short text of their quantity (for example, 1000 => 1k)
15) Highlighted slots in a unit’s inventory have become even brighter

[b]Added:[/b]
1) Durability indicator has been added to the Building Window
2) Component Disassembly Window - you can now drag a component into the Disassembly Window
3) Item Splitting Window - you can now drag an item into the Item Splitting Window
4) Technology slot - added display of required components on the slot itself in the form of small indicators
5) Technology tree - a new panel has been added to the technology overview panel, which duplicates technologies for opening this technology
6) Technology tree - a new research branch has been added - Technical Drone Station
7) For mining buildings in the Building Window, an indicator of the extraction time of one resource in seconds has been added
8) Trade - added a button "Remove all resources from the cargo shuttle"
9) Trade, item tooltips - an indicator of the trader’s percentage markup for this component has been added to the price
10) An indicator for transporting the Cargo Shuttle for the Trade has been added to the Building Overview Window
11) Wikipedia - new technologies added

[b]Fixed:[/b]
1) Fixed a problem where, during a Pause of the game, the Information panels in the Inventory window were not deleted and remained active
2) Lots of minor UI fixes
3) A small optimization of the building placement grid has been carried out
4) Fixed a bug when, after laying a cable web, an indicator remained on it indicating that the web was not connected to the building
5) Fixed a bug when resources were duplicated in the Conveyor web overview window
6) Fixed the problem of incorrect positioning of the context menu on the reader
7) Fixed an issue where it was impossible to move the camera while the Item Splitting panel was active
8) Fixed a bug where the Unit Dialog Panel would jerk when appearing

[h3][b]OLD saves will not work correctly. Sorry for the inconvenience! :([/b][/h3]

notes.title: Update v.0.2.331 (07/20/2023)
notes.content:
[b]v.0.2.331 (07/20/2023)[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
1) Technology research result icons have been replaced in the technology pop-up window
2) In building tooltips, the location of indicators for the consumption of liquids has been changed (for example, Water Power Plant). Now it is displayed in an intuitive way (maximum quantity/current quantity).
3) Now on the location map at the maximum distance, the icons of buildings will be replaced by white squares (for optimization purposes)
4) Technical Drone Station - now the station will send all free drones to containers to collect resources after the destruction of buildings
5) Now the maximum charge of units' Energy Cells will slowly decrease. Charge degradation occurs, and the maximum capacity will decrease. Recovery is not subject.
6) Reduced by 2 times the default number of drone slots for buildings - Technical Drone Station, Drone Factory, Crusher, Sawmill
7) Localization and text, some edits
8) Drones must now be present at the Sawmill to plant vegetation
9) Now the icons of pipelines in the Building Window will be divided into Input and Output
10) Technical Drone Station - service area reduced from 45 units to 40 units 

[b]Added:[/b]
1) Trading floor - an indicator has been added to the slots of the queue, which indicates which process the slot belongs to (sale or purchase)
2) Location map - on the icons of buildings, the display of the components or resources that they produce at the moment has been added
3) Technical Drone Station - functionality of work priorities for drones has been added. By default - construction, repair (not yet available) collection of resources. If you set the value to [-1], the operation of this complex will be suspended.
4) Added the functionality of Disassemble complex components and modules. To open the Disassembly Window, call the context menu on the component you want to disassemble, and then click the Disassemble button. Or use the shortcut button located under the Back Trunk icon in the unit's inventory next to the Sort Items button.
There will be a small penalty when disassembling the components. This means that you will receive fewer resources than when you create it. This fine may be reduced in the near future.
The disassembly window has 6x6 cells, in which resources will be created after the component is disassembled. You cannot place other items in this window, you can only pick it up! If a resource does not stack during disassembly, then it will be created in the amount of 1 pc.
5) Added a button to call the Disassembly window. Found next to the Sort Items button in the Back Trunk

[b]Corrected:[/b]
1) Fixed a problem with the reverse timer of traders, when they turned yellow with a large amount of time left
2) Fixed a problem with the loud sound of the Drone Factory
3) Technical Drone Station - fixed a bug when not all drones were sent to build buildings
4) Technical Drone Station - fixed a bug when drones did not take resources from containers
5) Technical Drone Station - fixed an issue where the drone would disappear when approaching a container that was close to the Technical Drone Station
6) Technical Drone Station - fixed the problem when the drone could not go to the building in order to transfer the required amount of resources to the building. The building already had a certain amount of resources, so the drone could not collect the required amount.
7) Trading floor - fixed a bug when the total cost of the items could become negative
8) Trading floor - fixed a bug when the resource icon was white in the buy window
9) Location map - fixed a problem when, at the maximum distance, no tooltips were created on the icons of buildings when hovering over
10) Location map - fixed a problem when, at the maximum distance, the icons of buildings did not change to white squares (to optimize performance)
11) Planting Vegetation - fixed a problem when new trees were not added to the list for production in the Sawmill if they fell into the Mining area
12) Location map - fixed a bug when a resource icon (Stone) appeared on all building icons
13) Location map - fixed a problem when the icons of buildings had an incorrect orientation after the building was rotated
14) Fixed a bug - when trying to move non-stackable items from a unit's inventory to a building (or vice versa) using the [Shift] key pressed, the items created their copies, after which the inventory hung

notes.title: v.0.2.243 (06/02/2023)
notes.content:
v.0.2.243 (06/02/2023)

Changes:
1) Now, when a unit is selected, sounds will sometimes be played
2) Building window - changed the appearance of debuff slots
3) Now the technology description window in the Technology Tree window can be moved
4) Localization and text, some edits
5) The result of technology research is duplicated on the technology slot
6) In the technology information window, instead of the general icons of the result of technology research, the correct icon of the component will be displayed
7) Now the trees that were planted by the Sawmill will be automatically added to the list for mining by drones if they are in the cutting area
8) Now the battery charge interface will not be shown in drone tooltips
9) In the building window, the interface for setting links between buildings is duplicated (relevant for the Local teleport and Matter Transponder)
10) Now in the sell or buy window, the icon of the tool will correspond to reality (with all the modules that are attached to it)
11) Reduced the chance of Sandstorm spawning in the Desert and Savanna
12) A delay has been introduced before displaying the collection radius at Storages

Added:
1) Added the effect of dust and flying stones when mining Rock or Mountains
2) Added the sound of a falling tree
3) Introduced a new debuff factor for component production time. If the strength of the building is less than 95%, then it will be taken into account when calculating the production time of the component. The maximum production time of a component can increase by 2 times.
4) Introduced a new debuff factor for resource clearing time. If the strength of the building is less than 95%, then it will be taken into account when calculating the time to clear the resource. The maximum resource cleanup time can increase by 2 times.
5) Added new sounds to buildings - Factory, Drilling Stations, Hydro Well, Water Pump, Water Converter
6) Now technologies will keep their progress after canceling the research, which will be indicated by a special indicator on the technology slot.
7) Global location map - now the icons of buildings will match the appearance of the building (there were white squares before)

Corrected:
1) Technology queue - fixed a bug when, after removing a technology from the queue, the queue was not rebuilt (there was a gap in the queue)
2) Fixed an issue where Tankers didn't render the resource gathering area

notes.title: v.0.2.151 (05/15/2023)
notes.content:
v.0.2.151 (05/15/2023)

Changes:
1) Improved tree planting animation. Now they appear more smoothly than before.
2) Changed the logic of restoring vegetation on the location. They can now spawn when the player's camera is directly in the landing area. Trees used to spawn out of view of the player's camera. This also applies to the evolution of vegetation.
3) Now the icons of buildings on the Location Map will be created along with the placement of the building. Previously, they were created only after their final construction.
4) Now the buildings will receive durability damage (0.5 units) for overloading the web in which they are located. The ratio may be changed in the future.
5) Building window - uranium slots have been moved to a separate panel at the bottom of the window
6) Building window - power cell charging slots have been moved to a separate panel at the bottom of the window
7) Now messages that the building is not connected to one of the webs will not appear in the tooltips of the building if this web is not yet available (not opened, not researched)

Added:
1) Wikipedia - added the section "Can be mined" to the buildings
2) Wikipedia - added the section "Can be mined in ..." to the resources
3) Building window, control section - for warehouses and tanks, a new parameter "Radius of gathering resources in the web" has been added. By default, a warehouse or tanks can request resources from the entire web when setting a collection radius. Buildings that are outside this radius will not be counted.
4) Units added a holographic eye shader
5) Building window - added display of debuffs that reduce the strength of the building (temporary location, in the future it will be moved to a separate window with a detailed description)
6) A message has been added to the tooltips of the building that the building is not connected to the pipeline web 

Corrected:
1) Fixed the issue where after researching a technology, the next technology in the queue would not start researching (Testing is required! Clear the queue and cancel the technologies that were sent for research.)
2) Fixed a bug when building tooltips displayed a message that the building was not connected to the conveyor web (although the building was connected to it)
3) Fixed an issue where it was not possible to cancel technology research, it would hang and the queue would not continue

notes.title: v.0.2.102 (04.05.2023)
notes.content:
v.0.2.102 (04.05.2023)

Changes:
1) Localization and text, some edits
2) Wikipedia, Technology section - now the icons of unlockable buildings, mechanics, items, etc. will be shown in the Unlockable panel (previously the general icon was shown)
3) Wikipedia, Technology section - now when you click on the icon of an opened component, its Wikipedia section will be opened
4) Now the Add to Virtual Container button will not be created in the context menu until the Virtual Container technology is researched
5) Now the volume of the building tank will also be displayed in the main Building Window
6) Now in the save load confirmation window the names of the world will be displayed
7) Many small changes
8) The recipe for building the Liquids-Gases Clearing Station has been changed. Increased the amount of Armored Glass in the recipe by 3 times

Added:
1) Wikipedia - added tutorial material on the Web System
2) Added informational text when generating large planets (generation may take some time)
3) Many small additions

Corrected:
1) Fixed an issue where the Sawmill could plant trees while being an inactive building
2) Fixed a problem when a tooltip with text could be behind the cursor
3) Fixed a problem when it was impossible to select the created preset in the character selection window due to an error that the character did not have the required modules
4) Many small fixes
5) Fixed an issue where the Resource Scan Station did not play the sound of the first wave

notes.title: Update v.0.1.976 (04/10/2023)
notes.content:
v.0.1.976 (04/10/2023)

Changes:
1) Localization and text, some edits

Added:
1) Wikipedia - statistics added to drones
2) Item Inspect Window - in the production and cleaning section, an icon of the building in which the item is produced has been added
3) Trading - an indicator has been added to the sell and buy window, indicating that the player or merchant does not have enough funds to buy or sell
4) Two new switches have been added to the location map - Show unit icons and Show building icons
5) Added the weather coefficient of destruction (aging) of objects on the location, such as units, buildings, etc. Previously, only temperature affected the aging of objects.
6) A new technology has been added - Planting Vegetation. The technology is in the General section. It gives access to the vegetation planting interface on the map. Now you can restore the forest even faster.
7) Added new game mechanics - Planting Vegetation. It is available at the Sawmill buildings after researching the relevant technology. The switch is in the Building Window, Settings section. Testing required!

Fixed:
1) Wikipedia - fixed incorrect display of the building in which barrels with resources are produced (was the Component Factory, it became the Spilling Station)
2) Fixed the problem of not displaying the rock on the mini map and location map
3) Fixed a bug when after canceling the placement of a building (with the Dronatization tool turned on), the scene remained bright, even in the dark time
4) Fixed the problem when placing a building in Grid mode, the Dronetization tool was activated, then deactivated, after which the Grid mode was not restored

notes.title: v.0.1.934 (03/26/2023)
notes.content:
v.0.1.934 (03/26/2023)

Changes:
1) Localization and text, some edits
2) Wikipedia - now the price of the item will be displayed in the short version. Hovering over a price will show a tooltip with the full price.
3) Improved appearance of the modules panel in the Building Window
4) Now the Building Window will not close when you press the [Esc] key if the action confirmation panel is active. The action confirmation window will close.
5) Repair time increased by 3 times (from 0.5s to 1.5s)
6) All tools have their repair factor adjusted
7) Now, when changing the module of a unit, a sound will sometimes be played in the Modding window
8) Adjusted the draw distance of the LODs for the Center and Water Pump buildings
9) Now the icons above the buildings (for example, No power) will be synchronized with each other and play the same animation (it used to be inconsistent)

Added:
1) Added a numerical designation of the charge of the Energy Cell in the slots for recharging Energy Cells
2) In the Build Window, the time for the construction of the selected building has been added
3) Wikipedia - added display of the characteristics of Tools and Modules
4) Added a confirmation panel for deleting a Building module from slots
5) Wikipedia's tutorial section has been updated. Added - virtual container
6) A new item has been added to the context menu of resources on the Trade - Wikipedia
7) In the Control section (game settings) added a search field
8) A building repair parameter has been introduced, which characterizes the maximum allowable strength of a building after repair. Experimental game mechanics. Testing required!
9) A new switch has been added to the Drone Factory Building Window, which indicates whether the factory can automatically send drones to buildings that need drones 
10) Now, if the building was disconnected from the conveyor web manually (through the Building window), the tooltips for the building will show a corresponding warning

Corrected:
1) Fixed a problem when after installing the module on the building, when the building window was opened again, the module disappeared
2) Fixed a problem when on Wikipedia the components in the cleaning section showed a different building in which they are cleaned
3) Fixed a bug when, when trying to send a unit to repair a building, it did nothing after taking the tool
4) Fixed a bug when, during the repair of a building, a unit could destroy it
5) Fixed a problem when during the acceleration of the game a tutorial window was called, after closing which the game speed was not restored to the previous one
6) Fixed a bug when, after saving a unit preset, an inscription appeared on the slot indicating that there were no critical modules
7) Fixed a bug when the Solar Panel, which was built in the night, did not follow the light source
8) Fixed a problem when in the Trade window when trying to close the Sell / Buy resources window, the Trade window was also closed

notes.title: v.0.1.853 (03/17/2023)
notes.content:
v.0.1.853 (03/17/2023)

Changes:
1) Localization and text, some edits
2) Changed the research recipe for Dronatization and Technical Drone Station technologies. Technologies has become more expensive.
3) Fixed drone production time (before the production time was 1 second)
4) Changed the recipe for creating drones. Added new components: Microprocessor and Servomotors
5) The web Reader will now display the amount of available stored energy from the web it is attached to. Previously, it showed all the collected energy.
6) Now, if the collected energy of a building is lower than available, it will be marked in red in tooltips for this building
7) Now the Short Range Power Tower will not take into account Short Range Power Towers that are under construction or destruction
8) Now it will be impossible to open the mini-map if the Global location map is open
9) Now on the Global location map, when hovering over the icon of buildings, a complete information tooltip of this type of building will be created. The same goes for the Build window.
10) Now, when the Surface Scan Station is selected, the sound of scanning the area will be played, provided that the station has already completed the scan of the area
11) The power web analysis panel of the building has been changed. Added arrows that indicate what the building is doing - receiving and (or) giving electricity to the web
12) Tech Drone Stations will no longer have access to the conveyor exit by default during construction. However, they will still be able to request resources from the web. To enable this setting, go to the build settings of the Buildings window.

Added:
1) Added priority [-1]. This priority indicates that the building will not accept drones from the Drone Factory
2) An indicator of unit operation has been added to the unit panel. The indicator shows what the unit is doing at the moment.
3) Added 12 sounds to the unit. Sounds will now play when the unit is doing work - moving, idle, mining, destroying, etc.
4) During the drop of cargo on the Trading floor, a laser beam and a sound of a laser beam, indicating the place of landing of the cargo, have been added
5) Added background sound of the Power Collector Station
6) Added a list of thanks to people who helped during the development of the game
7) The following information has been added to the save slots - the current researchable technology, time of day and current weather (available after re-saving the world)
8) Added name generator for units, drones and planets in Russian. Localization must be Russian.

Corrected:
1) Fixed a bug in the Crusher, when sometimes structural elements of the building levitated in the air
2) Fixed a bug when an empty tooltip was created on the icons of resource deposits on the Global location map
3) Fixed a bug when after closing the Global location map, the inventory was opened after a while
4) Fixed the problem when the tutorial window was not opened when calling the tutorial window via Wikipedia or in the Constructor window. This was preceded by a tick - Do not show again.
5) An attempt to fix a bug when Solar Panels could follow (turn face to face) the Sun at night. Need testing!

notes.title: v.0.1.784 (07/03/2023)
notes.content:
v.0.1.784 (07/03/2023)

Changes:
1) Now tooltips for buildings that are under building or destruction will not show informational icons (electricity consumption, etc.)
2) Now, when placing a Web Tower, the Power Grid analysis mode will automatically turn on (provided that it is available)
3) Localization and text, some edits
4) Now the tooltip text of the electricity produced by the grid reader will be marked red if it is less than the amount of electricity consumed
5) Corrected the header of the hints of web readers

Added:
1) When calling a tooltip for an item, the display of the amount of charge of the Energy Cell of the unit module in the Constructor has been added
2) Added a new module for the energy cell unit. The new crystalline core energy cell differs from the basic energy cell in that it holds more charge while weighing less.
3) Added information about the location in which it is located in the tooltips to the resources of the selected location - surface or underground
4) Added more detailed tooltip for drone slots
5) Drones section added to Wikipedia
[b]6) Added German localization (non-professional)[/b]

notes.title: v.0.1.733 (03.01.2023)
notes.content:
v.0.1.733 (03.01.2023)

[img]https://sun9-east.userapi.com/sun9-42/s/v1/ig2/o6jWqVB6u8k-50UjTdECK7v50xehPI4IrntToS1irKuSaQmcJal-D5mK2l2QTchLK-tl6lzKIdts2InXj48VZL45.jpg?size=1024x1024&quality=96&type=album[/img]

Changes:
1) Now, in order to open access to the research of the Carbonium chip-grant technology, it is necessary to research the Carbon technology
2) Web towers that are in building or destroying mode will no longer be taken into account when laying the web
3) Now the statistics of the unit in the inventory take into account the mass, temperature coefficient and module effects
4) Now in the analysis mode of the Electrocity grid, buildings under building will not create an information panel
5) Now, while the building copy tool is active, it will not be possible to open the Build window [B]
6) The initial teaching material is divided into 4 parts: Starting, Building, Production and Research

Added:
1) Added the Resource Analysis panel on the location. The panel access button is located in the drop location selection window next to the full tile information button
2) In wikipedia, in the sections of Processing and Production of components, icons of buildings have been added in which they can be produced or processed
3) In Wikipedia, mass and price indicators are added to the components
4) Added Trade technology
5) Added a new building - Trading floor
6) Added new game mechanics - Trade. Will become available after the construction of the Trading floor
7) A new button has been added to the context menu for quickly transferring a resource to a building for cleaning. To do this, the unit must be selected, then call the context menu on one of the buildings (Sawmill, Crusher or Ore Refiner Station).
The button will be available if the unit in the Rear Bay has the required resource.
8) In the Dronatization mode, a display of the current number of drones for buildings has been added
9) Added the Copy button to the context menu of buildings in Dronetization mode

Corrected:
1) Now the unit will not be able to move if it does not have wheels or a head
2) Fixed a bug when, after transferring a module or tool from a unit's slots to the unit back trunk, the unit's mass decreased
3) Fixed a bug where the tooltip did not appear on the slots in the technologies section on wiki, which indicated what this technology opens
4) Fixed a problem when, after turning on the building, some parameters did not appear in the Building window
5) Fixed a bug when two tooltips could be created at the same time both on the building and on resource deposits
6) Fixed a problem when, while the tool for copying buildings was active, the player pressed the button to open the Build window [B], the button was activated and nothing happened
7) Fixed a problem if the building of the Drone factory was completed at the time the Dronatization mode was active, the building did not have a prioritization interface
8) Fixed a problem when the prioritization interface was not created for new buildings when the Dronatization mode was active
9) Fixed a problem when, with the Dronatization mode active, the buildings that were deleted at that moment did not delete the communication line between themselves and the Drone factory

notes.title: v.0.1.562 (02.20.2023)
notes.content:
v.0.1.562 (02.20.2023)

Changes:
1) Localization and text, some edits
2) Now the player will not be able to select a character for a new game if it does not have at least one necessary (critical) module

Added:
1) Added info slots to building tooltips
2) Added 5 statistics to the unit's inventory - movement speed, rotation speed, health, durability, mass
3) Added dependence of unit movement speed on its mass. The larger it is, the lower the speed and vice versa. The increase in speed cannot be more than 50% of the unit's current speed.
4) Added an indicator of the inactivity of buildings
5) Added artificial satellites that revolve around the planet
6) An indicator about the absence of critical modules has been added to the character selection slots

Corrected:
1) Fixed a bug when after saving the world through the button in the settings menu, the text with information about the last time the world was saved was incorrect
2) Fixed a bug when a unit did not start mining resources after reassigning resources to mining. The unit stopped working and stood still
3) Fixed a problem when Rocks containing iron ore did not have this resource

notes.title: Update v.0.1.524 (02.14.2023)
notes.content:
v.0.1.524 (02.14.2023)

Changes:
1) Now, when placing the buildings Hydrowell, Wind Power Plants, Drilling Station of Solid Resources, Wind, Water or Stone maps will automatically turn on, depending on the type of buildings
2) In the Grid mode, the size of the docking elements for buildings has been increased by 2 times
3) Some buildings have revised electricity consumption in a calm state
4) Changed the starting set of resources in the Launch Shuttle
5) The recipe for the Component Factory has been changed. Removed ores from the recipe and replaced them with the appropriate ingots
6) Now, when you enter the Grid mode, the functionality for placing grid elements will automatically turn on
7) Increased the brightness of the projections that show the range of some buildings
8) Localization and text, some edits
9) The energy indicator of the logs has been increased from 9.3 to 10.5 kW
10) Changed inventory size of Power Collector Station from 3x3 to 4x2
 cells
11) Now the unit's statistics will be updated in the constructor depending on the modules attached to it

Added:
1) Added special text when placing some buildings, which explains where it is better to place the building. The text is located in the construction window
2) Added a battery indicator to the tooltip when hovering over a unit
3) The function to isolate the Power Collector Station from the web has been added, the switch is located in the Building Window in the settings section. Prohibit the building from giving electricity to the web. The building will still receive electricity from the grid. By default, the option is disabled.
4) In the game settings, a switch has been added to select the monitor on which the picture will be displayed. Need testing!
5) Wikipedia added statistics to resources, components and modules
6) Added a hint indicating that the object is outside the location and cannot be reached by the unit
7) A panel with hints has been added to the constructor, which indicates which critical modules the unit is missing
8) Added statistics to the tooltips of the module (Speed, Angular speed, etc.)
9) In the object Inspect window, indicators of the mass and size of the object have been added

Corrected:
1) Fixed a bug when in the Building window (when the Building Controls window is open) resources were not removed from the building inventory when auto-clearing ores in the Ore Clearing Station.
2) Fixed a bug when Wikipedia did not open after exiting the modding mode
3) Fixed a bug when the Liquid/Gas Clearing Station consumed a large amount of energy when idle
4) Fixed a bug when, after exiting to the main menu, the rain sound did not stop

notes.title: Update v.0.1.476 (02.07.2023) Bug fixes
notes.content:
v.0.1.476 (02.07.2023)

Changes:
1) Localization and text, some edits
2) Now in the production section of the Building window in the production result slot, the quantity of components that are currently being created will correspond to the quantity of produced components in the building settings
3) For mining drones, the storage size has been reduced from 4x2 to 2x2 cells

Added:
1) Added display of last save time in save slots
2) Added "Technology Required" section to the Technology section of Wikipedia to unlock the required technology
3) Added the ability to disable tasks when creating a new world. The switch is in the drop-down menu in the Game section. The option is enabled by default.
4) Added a window for Congratulating the completion of tasks

Fixed:
1) Fixed an autosave bug when after changing the autosave time frequency the new value was not taken into account
2) Fixed the bug of charging the energy-cell in the Power Collector Station, when after the energy-cell was fully charged, the station would no longer charge the energy-cells. Need testing!
3) Fixed a delay in closing the window for selecting a component for production. Now the production component selection window closes with the Building window.
4) Fixed a bug when, during the pause of the game, the player accelerated time and could no longer pause the game by pressing the Space key
5) Fixed a bug when, after loading the world, the task to land on the planet remained unfulfilled and the next task did not appear
6) Fixed a bug when after a long game the World could not be saved even when pressing the F5 quick save button
7) Fixed a problem when in the constructor with the active learning window it was possible to rotate the model on the stage
